title: Teamwork among Supreme Court judges is excellent: CJI Surya Kant Interview
description: In what could be a first, the Supreme Court of India has decided to constitute four dedicated benches to hear the oldest cases pending before it. Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant has described the move as an "experiment" will ultimately be judged by its results.In a conversation with Bar & Bench, the CJI says he is putting it to test and hopes the initiative, if successful, will become a model that future Chief Justices might want to emulate.
